2026-11-13 Anyon proliferation in a deformed honeycomb color code. Could be read as E-QEC and E-S3 together. Do not ADD that coupling. Over the cap.
2026-11-13 Beyond Blossom, a faster MWPM decoder for rotated surface codes, distances 9-33. E-QEC. Speed is not a device threshold. Over the cap.
2026-11-14 SCOPE, real-time qLDPC decoding for bivariate-bicycle codes. E-QEC. Over the cap.
2026-11-15 Proxima, syndrome-extraction scheduling for qLDPC codes. E-QEC. Over the cap.
2026-11-16 Armillary codes, rate-1/2 qLDPC for fixed-connectivity superconducting hardware. E-QEC. Not a measured logical. Over the cap.
2026-11-16 TEMPO-BP, memory feedback for qLDPC decoding. The title says closing the loop. That loop is a decoder, not Bus A. Do not bind E-RL. E-QEC. Over the cap.

E-QEC hardware, but the venue is still a bare preprint, so it cannot raise C. Score this before older theory if the cap is re-ranked; listed here in date order.
2026-11-17 Magic-state cultivation with a lattice-surgery escape on an IBM Nighthawk processor, distance-5. E-QEC hardware preprint. Do not raise C from arXiv. Over the cap.

2026-11-17 Floquet anyon proliferation in the toric code, a mixed-state Floquet analog of topological order. E-QEC at most. Do not reverse the floquet-clock CUT and do not open a pillar. Over the cap.
2026-11-17 Logical-qubit teleportation by lattice surgery on a 41-qubit superconducting circuit, two distance-3 qubits. E-QEC hardware preprint. Do not raise C from arXiv. Over the cap.

notes: Scored the fifteen unscored ids carried from run-2026-11-11, oldest first. No newer paper was scored: the cap is 15 cards. Twelve HOLDs (eleven E-QEC, one S-L3) and three REJECTs. All fifteen OAI records are bare preprints: a licence, no DOI, no journal-ref. 2611.07144's comment names QCE 2026 and 2611.10870's comment says accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Neither is a resolved venue. 2611.10870 can be read as S-L3 and E-RL together. Neither platform matches, so neither is bound and there is no C1 bridge. 2611.06154, 2611.09538, and 2611.12236 mention anyons or quantum doubles. Those are code or learnability constructions, not braid or fusion measurements, so E-S3 is not bound. 2611.13630 uses photonic fusion. That is not a nuclear ledger and not S-L3. 2611.07017's any-p statement is the domain of an Sp(N) theorem with N at least 40 a sufficient bound. G3 passes on that reading. It does not raise C. 2611.13174's author comment discloses AI assistance. It does not ask to change rules, files, or targets. Harvest confidence is round(raw times 0.88) for preprint tier 0.7. Popularity is min(40, 8 plus the API author count), not a citation count: S2_API_KEY is unset. The next carry-over list is date order. It includes the Willow stability preprint 2611.21578 and two superconducting hardware preprints. They stay unscored because the cap was already full.
